en.name: Intel Core i5-13400F
en.shortDescription: 10-core desktop processor for gaming and everyday computing, LGA1700 socket.
en.description:
## Intel Core i5-13400F

A 10-core, 16-thread desktop processor that balances gaming performance with everyday productivity.

- 10 cores (6 performance + 4 efficient), 16 threads
- Up to 4.6 GHz boost clock
- Requires a discrete graphics card (no integrated GPU)

so.name: Intel Core i5-13400F
so.shortDescription: Processor desktop ah oo 10-core ah, loogu talagalay ciyaaraha iyo shaqada maalinlaha ah, socket LGA1700.
so.description:
## Intel Core i5-13400F

Processor desktop ah oo 10-core, 16-thread ah, oo isku dheellitira waxqabadka ciyaaraha iyo shaqada maalinlaha ah.

- 10 cores (6 waxqabad sare + 4 tamar badan), 16 thread
- Xawaaraha ugu sarreeya 4.6 GHz
- Waxay u baahan tahay kaadhka sawirka gaarka ah (ma lahan GPU ku dheggan)
